name: Kale

pros.title: glucosinolate-rich brassica profile
pros.explanation: Kale brings a brassica-specific phytochemical angle beyond its vitamin bars.

pros.title: huge vitamin K and carotenoid story
pros.explanation: The standout micronutrient identity is the real reason kale scores so strongly.

pros.title: leafy volume with very low calorie pressure
pros.explanation: It adds a lot of plate volume without much energy load.

cons.title: freshness and prep can matter
cons.explanation: Older or badly prepared kale can turn tough and bitter fast.

cons.title: raw texture can be a barrier
cons.explanation: The chewy texture can make it harder to enjoy raw than softer greens.

cons.title: strong leafy flavour is not for everyone
cons.explanation: It is nutrient-dense, but some people just do not like the bitter leafy taste.
